name: image-quality-standard
mirrors: Creative Studio image-style-qa. That rubric lives as a box skill and is not in this repo. This file is the copy the repo scores against.
scale: 1 is unusable, 2 is amateur, 3 is competent but not shippable, 4 is professional, 5 is the reference still.

categories.title: Beginner clarity
categories.question: With the sound off, is this one idea a beginner can name?

categories.title: Composition and hierarchy
categories.question: Is there one subject, a clear headline, and quiet space, or is the frame a glowing box?

categories.title: Craft and polish
categories.question: Would this sit next to a polished crypto explainer still without looking code-drawn?

categories.title: Brand fidelity
categories.question: Navy, cyan, one keyword, mint only for sells, amber only for warnings?

categories.title: Text legibility
categories.question: Can every word be read at a glance, with spaces, at the intended weight?

categories.title: Character consistency
categories.question: If a character appears, is it the approved sheet in the locked box? A generated stand-in scores 1.

categories.title: Accuracy of labels and numbers
categories.question: Do the words and figures match the lesson, with no invented result?
